title: Native declared-run opening refuses (opening_unavailable) after a claim lapse, host restart, re-claim and re-name of the same item
outcome: Native declared-run opening refuses (opening_unavailable) after a claim lapse, host restart, re-claim and re-name of the same item
acceptance: A focused test reproduces the observed sequence through existing seams: claim, name (generation 1), claim lapse, host restart retiring generation 1, re-claim of the same item with a new claim id and fence, re-name as generation 2, then a native declared-run opening. On the current code the test fails with the refusal seen live, and the failing check in declared_run_opening_authority_locked is named.

After the fix, the same sequence opens natively and S0 is captured. The fix aligns the native opening precheck with the binding refresh the launcher registration already performs after same-root naming; it adds no new condition and nothing outside the agreed credit definition.
The cause is recorded on this item from the test, not inferred.
